headline: TAEYEON to hold solo concert 'F.L.Y.' at KSPO DOME in January
sub: First solo concert in about 1 year 10 months, then 5 Asian cities
source: Source: SM Entertainment, Soompi, Korea JoongAng Daily
caption:
Girls' Generation's TAEYEON will hold her solo concert 'F.L.Y.' at KSPO DOME in Seoul this January.

The Seoul shows run Jan 15–17, her first solo concert in about 1 year and 10 months since 'The TENSE' last March. After Seoul, she heads to Macau, Bangkok, Hong Kong, Taipei and Tokyo. The fan club presale opens Dec 1 at 8 PM KST, and general sales start Dec 3.
